description: This file provides helper functions for normalizing and fixing issues in table structures within a ProseMirror editor, such as overlapping cells, inconsistent row spans, and missing cells.

methods.name: fixTables
methods.description: Inspects all tables in the current editor state and returns a transaction that fixes any issues, optionally using a previous state to optimize re-scanning.

methods.name: fixTable
methods.description: Fixes a specific table node by resolving problems such as collisions, missing cells, overlong row spans, colwidth mismatches, and zero-sized cells, returning an updated transaction.
